metadata.description: The review skills behind Tekk's autonomous loops — one plugin per loop, each a shelf of methods.

plugins.name: tekk-security
plugins.description: The Security loop's skill library: one methodology per attack surface (auth & access, tenant isolation, money & webhooks, injection & input, secrets & crypto), each an Agent Skill with its own bundled references.

plugins.name: tekk-reliability
plugins.description: The reliability loop's skill library: one methodology per lens (dependency-boundary, retry-safety, resource-limits, failure-handling), each an Agent Skill the run can open mid-pass.
